name: Apply Ceiling Primer (Roll Method)
intent: Cut in to wall line freehand with brush, then roll primer onto bare drywall ceiling with an 18-inch roller on extension pole. Single coat of primer. Rolling overhead is significantly slower than rolling walls — both the cut-in and the field roll rates are ~80% of wall prime rates.
doctrine: Roll prime ceiling — pre-roll brushed cut-in (TSK_CEIL_CUT_IN_WALL_PRIME, prime-specific brush task) plus the universal TSK_ROLL_CEILING_FINISH field roll. FAC_MATERIAL fires (eligibility.material:true) → WB_PRIMER 1.25× time multiplier on top of the canonical finish rates. Pre-trim NC, painter draws the wall line first then rolls.
